senses.definition: A male animal, especially a stud horse (stallion), kept for breeding.
A female animal, especially a studmare (broodmare), kept for breeding.
(by extension, collective) A group of such animals, also of locomotives.

senses.definition: An animal (usually livestock) that has been registered and is retained for breeding.
